input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

tool_calls: cat /data/poem.txt; echo; awk '{ for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){ w=tolower($i); gsub(/^[^[:alnum:]]+|[^[:alnum:]]+$/, "", w); if(w!="") c[w]++ }} END { for(w in c) print w, c[w] }' /data/poem.txt | sort -k2,2nr | head -3

tool_outputs.commands: cat /data/poem.txt; echo; awk '{ for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){ w=tolower($i); gsub(/^[^[:alnum:]]+|[^[:alnum:]]+$/, "", w); if(w!="") c[w]++ }} END { for(w in c) print w, c[w] }' /data/poem.txt | sort -k2,2nr | head -3
tool_outputs.stdout:
the cat sat on the mat
the cat in the hat
the dog on the log
the frog on the bog

the 8
on 3
